custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In mechanical images, AI often fails to render crisp, legible brand names or part numbers. If the text auditor confirms these are nonsensical glyphs, this is a strong indicator of AI generation despite the high structural fidelity of the main components. Also, verify if the 'cross-drilled' holes on the rotor maintain consistent depth and perspective, or if they flatten/warp near the edges.

A caliper assembly is mounted over the edge of the rotor, containing brake pads. Various mechanical linkages, bolts, and part of the wheel hub structure are visible in the background. The lighting creates high contrast reflections on the metallic surfaces.
